0.content: **Node Overview**: One node looks different from the others: its uptime, connections, resources and errors, side by side. A tile's description shows its equivalent Prometheus query.

2.query:
timeseries value = avg(aerospike_node_up, filter: { cluster_name == $cluster and in(service, array($node)) }), by: { build, cluster_name, node_id, service }
| fields build, cluster_name, node_id, service, value = coalesce(value[-2], arrayLast(value))
2.description:
Equivalent Prometheus query:
aerospike_node_up{job="$job_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster|$^", service=~"$node|$^"}

4.content:
### Aerospike Version

_Not available in Dynatrace yet (count_values()). The equivalent Prometheus query:_

```promql
count_values by (build) ("build_numbers", (aerospike_node_up{job="$job_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster", service=~"$node|$^"}) )
```

5.content:
### Alerts

_Not available in Dynatrace yet (Prometheus alert state (ALERTS) -- alerts are not in Dynatrace). The equivalent Prometheus query:_

```promql
count by (severity) (ALERTS{job="$job_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster", service=~"$node", ns=~"$namespace|$^", severity=~"warn|critical|info|error"}) 
```

19.content:
### % Set Quota used (topk)

_Not available in Dynatrace yet (arithmetic between series that are already summarized, sorted or counted). The equivalent Prometheus query:_

```promql
topk(3,sort_desc((
  (aerospike_sets_memory_data_bytes{job="$job_name",cluster_name=~"$cluster", service=~"$node|$^", ns=~"$namespace|$^"}+aerospike_sets_device_data_bytes{job="$job_name",cluster_name=~"$cluster", service=~"$node|$^", ns=~"$namespace|$^"})
  /(aerospike_sets_stop_writes_size{job="$job_name",cluster_name=~"$cluster", service=~"$node|$^", ns=~"$namespace|$^"}!=0) )*100))
topk( 3, (
  (aerospike_sets_data_used_bytes{job="$job_name",cluster_name=~"$cluster", service=~"$node|$^", ns=~"$namespace|$^"})
  /(aerospike_sets_stop_writes_size{job="$job_name",cluster_name=~"$cluster", service=~"$node|$^", ns=~"$namespace|$^"}!=0) )*100) 
```
